propositions: Reconciler transport parameters were unannotated or annotated as Any, preventing mypy from enforcing port completeness at call sites.
Absolute imports via the rebar_reconciler sys.path shim cause mypy to widen types to Any due to ignore_missing_imports, making annotations silently unenforceable regardless of Protocol definition.
Relative imports within the package restore mypy's ability to resolve TicketTransport and enforce attribute access, even with the _TransportPortMeta metaclass present.

Four capability members (add_comment, set_relationship, get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map) are carried as metaclass attributes so not visible to mypy's Protocol attribute collection, requiring composed/narrowed views at call sites.
The fix requires both annotating transport parameters with the Port type AND importing that type via a path mypy resolves, else the annotation silently enforces nothing.
